svg.title: Contextual Alignment
svg.desc: A left-right comparison graphic showing 10 Ligconsolata Next samples. The left side is shaped from a smoke-built font with liga, dlig, and calt enabled, and the right side is the same raw ASCII source with ligatures disabled.
svg.text: Contextual alternates align punctuation without changing source meaning.
上下文变体只做视觉对齐，不改变源码含义。

g.text: Mixed-height contexts such as A:b and a:B stay raw.
A:b、a:B 这种混合高度上下文保持原始字形。
:< / :> use visual alternates, not .dlig ligature glyphs.
:< / :> 使用视觉变体，不是新的 .dlig 连字。
